blue_bots.name: Botimus Prime
blue_bots.description: In 1v1, Botimus tries to play passive, only going for clears and safe shots. If it has teammates however, it goes for the ball all the time :P
blue_bots.fun_fact: The original Botimus Prime made its first appearance in RLBot 2018 august tournament, casted by none other than Liefx!

blue_bots.name: Beast from the East
blue_bots.description: A proud Merc bot that uses a utility system to decide wether to defend, dribble, score, or you know just eat the opponent alive.
blue_bots.fun_fact: 'Beast' is actually short for 'Bot made by Eastvillage', and 'from the East' also means 'made by Eastvillage'.
